title: AION 2 Gathering: Skills and Node Routes
description: Gather materials for your first recipe: material quantities, promotion and resource routes.
summary: Exact starter materials, a gathering allocation and the Asmodian Novice-50 Ruby promotion.
quickAnswer: For one starter sword attempt, gather 6 Orichalcum Ore and 2 Odyle, buy 3 Solvent and collect 5 Refining Stones. Specialize in Odyle plus your recipe resource. At Novice 50, Asmodians complete Alzirr’s Ruby promotion in Safe Haven.
